start.text:
Welcome to Stonerock News Corp's interactive coverage of Episodes 15-18. Orion City Prison has been flattened by the SS Piccius, Squidopia is on the run, and the newsroom is falling apart.

Choose your protagonist to navigate the chaos:

choices.text: Rick Sick Tick (Exposing the conspiracy)
Chick Van Miller (Fired, kidnapped, and trapped)
Nerdy News Reporter (The Polyester Savior)

rick_start.text:
[Episode 15/16]
You are Rick Sick Tick, watching the chaos of the prison collapse from your apartment. The police are calling it 'heavy rain'. You've had enough. You must run to the Stonerock News Corp skyscraper to broadcast the truth.

choices.text: Sprint straight through the crowded streets of Orion City
Stop to ask a random pedestrian for directions

rick_pedestrian.text:
You grab a pedestrian by the shoulder.
'HEY! WHERE'S STONEROCK NEWS CORP?'
Pedestrian: '...The building with the giant microphone on the roof.'
You realize you are looking right at it, but in your panic, you sprint in the complete opposite direction before correcting yourself.

choices.text: Double back and kick open the News HQ doors

rick_news_hq.text: You burst into the News HQ and bypass the guards shouting 'CODE VERMILLION!'. You reach the broadcast room, but the crew has no camera. The Director says Chick Ban Miller (the chicken) ran onto the roof with it.

choices.text: Chase the chicken up to the roof
Demand Trevor No find the camera instead

rick_trevor_refusal.text:
You demand Trevor No look for the camera.
Trevor No looks you in the eye and says: 'No.'
While you waste time arguing, the guards catch up and arrest you for trespassing.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_roof.text:
[Episode 16]
You reach the roof. Chick Ban Miller is standing on the ledge holding the camera. Trevor No is there, and the Nerdy Reporter tries a dramatic parkour roll to grab him, but misses completely. You need that camera to go live.

choices.text: Order the Nerdy Reporter to tackle Trevor No
Try to bribe the chicken with a worm

rick_chicken_bribe.text:
You offer Chick Ban Miller a worm. The chicken drops the camera to peck aggressively at the worm, but it slips off the ledge and falls 80 stories down into a police truck.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_tackle_trevor.text:
The Nerdy Reporter gets a burst of confidence: 'AND YOU'RE ABOUT TO GET... POLYESTERED!'
He tackles Trevor No, and you secure the camera. The Director yells: 'QUICK! FILM THE BROADCAST!'

choices.text: Sing the Stonerock theme song first
Skip the song and start talking immediately

rick_broadcast_fail.text:
You refuse to sing the theme song. The Director refuses to broadcast without it, calling security to throw you out of the building.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_broadcast_live.text:
You sing the song and reveal the truth: Squidopia is turning humans into cruise ships! The broadcast ends, and Rica Sica Tica watches from home. 

Now you must find the secret Stonerock HQ. You run back to the streets with the Director and Nerdy Reporter.

choices.text: Investigate the tall, abandoned glass building
Stop at the seal plushie factory first

rick_seal_factory.text:
[Episode 17]
You pause at the seal plushie factory. The Nerdy Reporter runs inside, trips, and emerges clutching a plushie, screaming that it's 100% polyester. With the detour finished, you turn to the giant office building next door: the Stonerock HQ.

choices.text: Kick down the front door of Stonerock HQ

rick_find_hq.text: You kick down the door and enter a lobby with a StonerockCoin vending machine selling coins for $0.000000000000000001.

choices.text: Let the Nerdy Reporter put a penny in the machine
Bypass the machine and drag everyone into the elevator

rick_vending_explode.text:
The vending machine instantly explodes with millions of physical StonerockCoins, burying the lobby and trapping you forever under worthless cryptocurrency.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_elevator_enter.text: You board the elevator. Suddenly, it starts plunging downwards. The indicator counts past -15, heading straight down to Floor -82.

choices.text: Try to pry the elevator doors open mid-plummet
Brace for impact at the bottom

rick_elevator_crush.text:
You force the doors open, but the speed of the falling elevator shears the emergency cables. The carriage plummets into the pit.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_floor_82.text:
[Episode 18]
The elevator crashes into Floor -82. You step out into a massive, dark room. You find Chick Van Miller trapped inside a glass tube. Squidopia stands by the controls, ready to activate 'The Process'.

choices.text: Throw a 100% polyester plushie into the control panel
Attempt to reason with Squidopia by offering him $2

rick_reactor_death.text:
You offer him $2. Squidopia laughs, calls his agents, and throws you into the SS Mortus nuclear reactor core.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_win.text:
The polyester plushie causes a massive electrostatic short circuit in the system, shattering the glass containment tube. Chick Van Miller is freed! Squidopia escapes via jetpack, but you have saved your friends!

YOU WIN!

choices.text: Play Again

chick_start.text:
[Episode 15]
You are Chick Van Miller. Fired by the Director, you are dragged away by a mysterious figure in a truck. You arrive at a dark facility. 
'Who are you?' you ask.
Figure: 'You ask too many questions. That's literally your job.'
What do you do?

choices.text: Try to jump out of the moving truck
Wait until the truck stops

chick_truck_jump.text:
You leap from the moving truck, but you land directly in the path of the SS Piccius as it is flung from the water onto the prison. You are flattened.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_facility_arrival.text: The truck stops. You are thrown into a tight cell. Suddenly, a sharp, aggressive PECK sounds from the high, barred window. It's Chick Ban Miller, your pet chicken spy!

choices.text: Yell at him to grab the keys
Try to slip through the bars yourself

chick_bars_stuck.text:
You try to squeeze through the bars but get stuck. The agents find you, laugh at your predicament, and drag you straight to 'The Process'.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_keys_ask.text:
You scream: 'QUICK, GRAB THE KEYS! CHEW THROUGH THE BARS!'
Instead, Chick Ban Miller turns around, begins aggressively pecking at a worm, and hops off the window sill.

choices.text: Sigh and wait in your cell

chick_agents_arrive.text: A tall, dark figure steps inside and says: 'You're next.' You are led down a dark hallway to a glass containment tube. Squidopia steps out of the shadows: 'It's called the SS Mortus for a reason.'

choices.text: Step into the glass tube
Refuse and fight the agents

chick_fight_agents.text:
You try to fight back, but there are dozens of armed agents. They overpower you and throw you directly into the nuclear reactor core.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_tube_descent.text:
[Episode 16]
You are sealed in the glass containment tube. It begins to descend into the decks below. You end up in a massive, unlit square room aboard the SS Mortus. There are no doors or windows.

choices.text: Cry out for your viewers

chick_cry_out.text:
You whisper: 'Stonerock... our decisions are always clever... please help me...'
Suddenly, a silhouette emerges from the darkness.

choices.text: Shine your watch light on the silhouette

chick_peter_reveal.text:
You see the face. It's Peter Pickle!
'Peter! You're alive!'
Peter Pickle: 'I used to remember how long I've been trapped here. It's too late for us.'
Suddenly, the elevator crashes open, and Rick Sick Tick bursts in.

choices.text: Shout to Rick for help
Try to escape through the ventilation shaft behind Peter

chick_vent_escape.text:
You crawl into the vents, but get lost in the exhaust system of the hybrid solar-diesel drive. The reactor starts up, filling the vents with fumes.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_final_stand.text: Squidopia prepares to activate the machine. Rick Sick Tick throws a polyester plushie, short-circuiting the power grid! The glass tube shatters, and you break free.

choices.text: Flee to safety with Rick

chick_win.text:
You escape Floor -82, reunite with the crew, and prepare to host the ultimate exposure broadcast. You are safe!

YOU WIN!

choices.text: Play Again

nerdy_start.text:
[Episode 15]
You are the Nerdy News Reporter. The Director has fired Chick Van Miller and hired you as the new anchor! Your mommy bought you a 100% polyester suit for your big day.

choices.text: Put on the polyester suit and head to the studio desk
Refuse to wear the suit because it's itchy

nerdy_itchy_fail.text:
You refuse to wear the suit. The Director fires you on the spot before your first broadcast.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_studio.text:
You are on live television! You announce that StonerockCoin has dropped to $0.0000005, meaning you lost your entire allowance. 
Suddenly, Rick Sick Tick bursts into the studio demanding the camera.

choices.text: Follow Rick to the roof to find the camera
Stay at the desk to complain about your allowance

nerdy_desk_fail.text:
You stay at the desk, weeping. The studio roof collapses as the SS Piccius flattens the adjacent prison, burying the newsroom.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_roof_chase.text:
[Episode 16]
You reach the roof. Trevor No is refusing to help. You try a dramatic parkour roll to grab the camera from Chick Ban Miller, but you miss and slide behind Trevor.

choices.text: Lunge forward and tackle Trevor No
Apologize and cry for your mommy

nerdy_mommy_cry.text:
You start crying. Trevor No pushes you off the ledge of the skyscraper.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_tackle.text:
You tackle Trevor No to the floor. 
'AND YOU'RE ABOUT TO GET... POLYESTERED!'
You pin him, allowing Rick to start the broadcast. After the exposure, Rick leads you to find the secret Stonerock HQ.

choices.text: Follow Rick to the tall glass building
Insist on visiting the seal plushie factory next door

nerdy_factory.text:
[Episode 17]
You run into the seal plushie factory and find a plushie that is 100% polyester! You carry it with pride as you head back to Rick at Stonerock HQ.

choices.text: Enter the Stonerock HQ lobby

nerdy_hq_arrival.text: In the lobby, you find a vending machine selling StonerockCoin at a extreme discount. You have one penny.

choices.text: Put the penny in the machine to buy the coin
Ignore the machine and follow Rick into the elevator

nerdy_vending_boom.text:
The machine explodes, burying the lobby in millions of coins. Your polyester suit protects you from the heat, but you are trapped in the rubble.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_elevator.text: You enter the elevator, which plummets straight down to Floor -82. You crash to the floor, face-down, still holding your polyester plushie.

choices.text: Get up and face Squidopia

nerdy_floor_82.text:
[Episode 18]
You see Squidopia preparing to turn Chick Van Miller into the SS Chiccius. You need to stop him, but the agents are closing in.

choices.text: Throw your 100% polyester seal plushie into the console
Try to buy a limited edition StonerockCoin on your phone

nerdy_phone_fail.text:
You open your phone to buy the coin. It drains your bank account instantly, and you are distracted as the agents grab you and throw you into the reactor.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_win.text:
The polyester plushie hits the control deck, creating a massive electrical arc that overloads the system and shatters the containment tube. Chick Van Miller is saved, and you escape with the crew!

YOU WIN!

choices.text: Play Again
